trans-unit.source: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
trans-unit.target: Um estranho encapuzado aparece uma noite, oferecendo sua ajuda por uma pequena taxa. Você aceita a ajuda?

trans-unit.source: The Stranger
trans-unit.target: O Estranho

trans-unit.source: An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
trans-unit.target: Um mensageiro élfico chega, procurando por um Idrinth. O Idrinth que você conhece o evitou até agora, talvez você possa ajudar?

trans-unit.source: A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
trans-unit.target: Uma patrulheira elfa da floresta chega ao seu acampamento. Afirmando que precisa de seu primo ensanguentado. Enquanto Idrinth rapidamente confirma que era ele o procurado, ele se recusa a encontrá-la.

trans-unit.source: An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
trans-unit.target: Uma velha estudiosa se aproxima do seu acampamento. Carregando livros do passado, ela afirma ter encontrado conhecimento valioso para você.

trans-unit.source: At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
trans-unit.target: À noite, enquanto um vento gelado tortura seus guardas, eles capturam um kislevita tentando entrar furtivamente no acampamento. Ele é jovem e aparentemente inofensivo, mas o que você faz com ele?

trans-unit.source: One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
trans-unit.target: Uma noite você encontra um de seus servos drenado de sangue bem do lado de fora da tenda de Idrinth. Entrando apressadamente, você o encontra lendo um pergaminho antigo sentado à sua mesa.

trans-unit.source: The Messeger
trans-unit.target: O Mensageiro

trans-unit.source: Blood Cousins
trans-unit.target: Primos de Sangue

trans-unit.source: Intruder!
trans-unit.target: Intruso!

trans-unit.source: The Scholar
trans-unit.target: A Estudiosa

trans-unit.source: The Servant's End
trans-unit.target: O Fim do Servo

trans-unit.source: A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
trans-unit.target: Um grupo de anões foi avistado nas proximidades. Seus batedores ouviram suas histórias sobre as guerras vampíricas. Um elfo mencionado parece suspeitosamente com Idrinth.

trans-unit.source: An old feud
trans-unit.target: Uma Antiga Rixa

trans-unit.source: After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Após a última caçada, Idrinth se aproxima de você com o que parece ser uma antiga arma élfica. Ele pede seu conselho sobre a quem dedicá-la.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Weapon
trans-unit.target: Uma Arma Abençoada

trans-unit.source: After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Após a última batalha, Idrinth se aproxima de você com o que parece ser uma antiga armadura élfica. Ele pede seu conselho sobre a quem dedicá-la.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Armour
trans-unit.target: Uma Armadura Abençoada

trans-unit.source: After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Após terminar a viagem do dia, Idrinth se aproxima de você com o que parece ser um antigo talismã élfico. Ele pede seu conselho sobre a quem dedicá-lo.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Talisman
trans-unit.target: Um Talismã Abençoado

trans-unit.source: Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
trans-unit.target: Ative a fidelidade ao lore mais restrita para limitar as culturas recrutadoras para o Cavaleiro-Erudito Idrinth Thalui a Altos Elfos, Elfos da Floresta, Kislev, O Império e Condes Vampiros. Escolha o modo menos restrito para ter Costa Vampírica, Legiões de Nagash, Elfos Negros, Cathay e Bretônia na lista também.

trans-unit.source: Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness
trans-unit.target: Modo: Fidelidade ao Lore Mais ou Menos Restrita

trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: Após aceitar sua moeda, o estranho se apresenta como um companheiro Asur chamado Idrinth. Tirando seus mantos de viagem, você vê a armadura de combate de um mestre do saber, uma espada larga combinando e um arco de metal perto de olhos estoicos que sugerem brutalidades ainda por cometer.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: Espero lutar ao lado dos caçadores das florestas, primo, declara o asur em tom amigável enquanto guarda seu pagamento e manto de viagem. Posso não ser tão bom atirador quanto vocês, mas não vou atrasá-los. Um sorriso levemente divertido brinca em seus lábios sem sangue antes de desaparecer. Vamos ter uma caçada que será contada por séculos!

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: O estranho se despe após receber o pagamento e revela um rosto élfico e armamento élfico sob seus mantos de viagem. Meu nome é Idrinth, tenho lutado contra nossos inimigos por mais tempo do que a maioria de vocês viveu. Eu gostaria de praticar com a força e ensiná-los. Um leve sorriso brinca em seus lábios sem sangue antes de desaparecer em um rosto sem idade.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: Eu lutei e sangrei com guerreiros que acreditam em Ulric ou Sigmar. Temos os mesmos inimigos, ele declara enquanto remove seus mantos de viagem, e espero expulsá-los junto com vocês. Compartilhando meu conhecimento para o bem do mundo. Seus olhos olham friamente para humanos orando antes de retornar sua atenção ao general e sua guarda.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: O estranho abaixa seu capuz, revelando feições élficas. Não sou amigo da destruição, mas nossos inimigos forçaram minha mão. Guardando suas moedas, ele declara: Retornar à família após muitos anos quando estão em perigo é certo, não importa quem seja essa família. Você não concorda?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: Do you want to enable the Thaluian Chapels for your campaign? They offer further defenses and options compared to just having the hero.
trans-unit.target: Você quer habilitar as Capelas Thaluianas para sua campanha? Elas oferecem mais defesas e opções comparadas a ter apenas o herói.

trans-unit.source: The black spires of Drakenhof castle pierce the perpetual gloom of Sylvania. Idrinth stands motionless before its gates, memories of the Vampire Wars flooding back unbidden. "I bled here," he whispers, "and rose again. The Von Carsteins taught me what I had become—whether I wished to learn or not." His hand rests on his sword hilt. Does he enter as a kinsman of blood, or as a reminder of what their ambition cost the world?
trans-unit.target: As torres negras do castelo Drakenhof perfuram a escuridão perpétua da Sylvânia. Idrinth permanece imóvel diante de seus portões, memórias das Guerras Vampíricas inundando-o involuntariamente. Eu sangrei aqui, ele sussurra, e renasci. Os Von Carstein me ensinaram o que eu havia me tornado—quisesse eu aprender ou não. Sua mão repousa no cabo da espada. Ele entra como parente de sangue, ou como um lembrete do que sua ambição custou ao mundo?

trans-unit.source: The Temple of Khaine rises from Naggaroth's wastes, its altars slick with fresh offerings. Idrinth feels the Murder God's gaze upon him—not with hatred, but with hungry recognition. "You know my blade's count," he murmurs to the bloody dark. "Every chaos-spawn I've ended, every daemon I've banished. Does that please you, Bloody-Handed One? Or do you merely await the day I turn it upon the innocent?"
trans-unit.target: O Templo de Khaine ergue-se dos desertos de Naggaroth, seus altares escorregando com oferendas frescas. Idrinth sente o olhar do Deus do Assassinato sobre ele—não com ódio, mas com reconhecimento faminto. Você conhece a conta da minha lâmina, ele murmura para a escuridão sangrenta. Cada servo do caos que eliminei, cada demônio que bani. Isso te agrada, Mão Sangrenta? Ou você apenas aguarda o dia em que eu a volte contra os inocentes?

trans-unit.source: The Sword of Khaine pulses with malevolent promise, its whispers cutting through even Idrinth's undead stillness. For a long moment, he simply stares at the Widowmaker. "Aenarion took you up to save our people and damned his line forever," he says quietly. "I was already damned when I swore my oath of vengeance. Would you make me worse, or merely... more efficient?" His fingers twitch, but do not reach.
trans-unit.target: A Espada de Khaine pulsa com promessa malévola, seus sussurros cortando até mesmo a quietude morta-viva de Idrinth. Por um longo momento, ele simplesmente olha para a Fazedora de Viúvas. Aenarion a empunhou para salvar nosso povo e condenou sua linhagem para sempre, ele diz baixinho. Eu já estava condenado quando fiz meu juramento de vingança. Você me tornaria pior, ou simplesmente... mais eficiente? Seus dedos tremem, mas não alcançam.

trans-unit.source: The sacred flames of Asuryan's temple burn eternal, and Idrinth approaches no further than the outer courtyard. "I walked these halls as a living elf," he says, his voice hollow. "I prayed here before marching to war against the undead. Now I am what I fought." He watches the flames dance. "Do you still hear me, Lord of the Phoenix? Or does my curse make my prayers into mockery?"
trans-unit.target: As chamas sagradas do templo de Asuryan queimam eternamente, e Idrinth não se aproxima mais do que o pátio externo. Eu caminhei por esses corredores como um elfo vivo, ele diz, sua voz oca. Eu orei aqui antes de marchar para a guerra contra os mortos-vivos. Agora eu sou o que combati. Ele observa as chamas dançarem. Você ainda me ouve, Senhor da Fênix? Ou minha maldição transforma minhas orações em zombaria?

trans-unit.source: Ancient trees frame the hunting shrine, and the scent of wild places fills the air. Idrinth breathes deep—an old habit from when breath meant life. "I hunt still, Lord of the Wild," he addresses the antlered stones. "Though I am no longer part of nature's cycle. I take no prey for sustenance of the body, only for vengeance of the spirit. Does the eternal hunt have room for one such as I?"
trans-unit.target: Árvores antigas emolduram o santuário de caça, e o cheiro de lugares selvagens preenche o ar. Idrinth respira fundo—um velho hábito de quando respirar significava vida. Eu ainda caço, Senhor do Selvagem, ele se dirige às pedras com chifres. Embora eu não faça mais parte do ciclo da natureza. Não pego presas para sustento do corpo, apenas para vingança do espírito. A caça eterna tem espaço para alguém como eu?

trans-unit.source: The Shrine of Loec shifts in the corner of one's vision, never quite where it seems. Idrinth allows himself a rare, cold smile. "The Trickster God. I have learned your arts, after a fashion—shadow magic came easier to me after death than it ever did in life." He performs a mocking half-bow. "Is that your joke, Laughing One? That I dance better now that my feet are cold?"
trans-unit.target: O Santuário de Loec muda no canto da visão, nunca exatamente onde parece estar. Idrinth se permite um raro e frio sorriso. O Deus Trapaceiro. Aprendi suas artes, de certa forma—a magia das sombras veio mais fácil para mim após a morte do que jamais veio em vida. Ele faz uma reverência zombeteira. É essa sua piada, Risonho? Que eu danço melhor agora que meus pés estão frios?

trans-unit.source: The marshes of Hel Fenn stretch before him, and Idrinth's expression becomes unreadable. "This is where it ended. And began." His voice carries no emotion. "I remember the mud. The blood. Mannfred's host crumbling around us. I remember thinking we had won." A long pause. "I do not remember dying. Only waking, three nights later, hungry for something I could not name."
trans-unit.target: Os pântanos de Hel Fenn se estendem diante dele, e a expressão de Idrinth torna-se ilegível. Foi aqui que terminou. E começou. Sua voz não carrega emoção. Lembro-me da lama. Do sangue. Do exército de Mannfred desmoronando ao nosso redor. Lembro-me de pensar que havíamos vencido. Uma longa pausa. Não me lembro de morrer. Apenas de acordar, três noites depois, faminto por algo que não conseguia nomear.

trans-unit.source: Nagash's monument looms against the desert sky, radiating power that makes Idrinth's curse writhe within him. "The father of all our damnation," he says, neither reverent nor contemptuous—merely stating fact. "Every vampire exists because you reached too far, Great Necromancer. My curse flows from your ambition." He studies the ancient stones. "I wonder—do you approve of how I use your gift? Turning death against Chaos itself?"
trans-unit.target: O monumento de Nagash ergue-se contra o céu do deserto, irradiando poder que faz a maldição de Idrinth contorcer-se dentro dele. O pai de toda nossa condenação, ele diz, nem reverente nem desdenhoso—apenas declarando fatos. Todo vampiro existe porque você alcançou longe demais, Grande Necromante. Minha maldição flui de sua ambição. Ele estuda as pedras antigas. Pergunto-me—você aprova como uso seu presente? Voltando a morte contra o próprio Caos?

trans-unit.source: The forge-shrine of Vaul radiates ancient power, and Idrinth's enchanted weapons seem to hum in response. "I carried weapons blessed at lesser forges into the Vampire Wars," he recalls. "They shattered against the undead. Now I am undead, and I carry weapons that would have slain what I became." His fingers trace his blade's edge. "There is poetry in that, of the sort only the Maker would appreciate."
trans-unit.target: O santuário-forja de Vaul irradia poder ancestral, e as armas encantadas de Idrinth parecem zumbir em resposta. Eu carreguei armas abençoadas em forjas menores para as Guerras Vampíricas, ele relembra. Elas se quebraram contra os mortos-vivos. Agora eu sou morto-vivo, e carrego armas que teriam matado o que me tornei. Seus dedos traçam o fio de sua lâmina. Há poesia nisso, do tipo que só o Fazedor apreciaria.

trans-unit.source: The Dark Elves claim their own connection to the Smith God, their forges burning with bitter industry. Idrinth observes without approaching. "Cousins," he muses. "They fell to one darkness, I to another. Yet they chose their path. I wonder sometimes if that makes them more honest than I—they embraced what they became, while I still pretend I am what I was."
trans-unit.target: Os Elfos Negros reivindicam sua própria conexão com o Deus Ferreiro, suas forjas queimando com indústria amarga. Idrinth observa sem se aproximar. Primos, ele reflete. Eles caíram em uma escuridão, eu em outra. Contudo, eles escolheram seu caminho. Pergunto-me às vezes se isso os torna mais honestos do que eu—eles abraçaram o que se tornaram, enquanto eu ainda finjo ser o que era.

trans-unit.source: The Wood Elves maintain Vaul's teachings in their own way, shaping living wood alongside dead metal. Idrinth watches the craftwork with scholarly interest. "Life and death married in a single weapon," he observes. "The Asrai understand something the other kindreds do not—that the boundary is more... permeable than we like to believe." A ghost of his old academic fascination surfaces. "I should study their techniques."
trans-unit.target: Os Elfos da Floresta mantêm os ensinamentos de Vaul à sua própria maneira, moldando madeira viva junto com metal morto. Idrinth observa o artesanato com interesse acadêmico. Vida e morte casadas em uma única arma, ele observa. Os Asrai entendem algo que as outras linhagens não entendem—que a fronteira é mais... permeável do que gostamos de acreditar. Um fantasma de sua antiga fascinação acadêmica emerge. Devo estudar suas técnicas.

trans-unit.source: The White Tower rises impossibly high, repository of all High Elven knowledge. Idrinth stops at the base, unable—or unwilling—to enter. "I was a Loremaster," he says, voice cracking with ancient grief. "I studied within those halls. I knew the secret ways, the hidden libraries, the forbidden sections." His eyes do not blink. "Do they still speak my name? Or have they struck it from the records, pretending I never existed?"
trans-unit.target: A Torre Branca ergue-se impossivelmente alta, repositório de todo conhecimento dos Altos Elfos. Idrinth para na base, incapaz—ou relutante—de entrar. Eu fui um Mestre do Saber, ele diz, voz quebrando com luto ancestral. Estudei dentro daqueles corredores. Conhecia os caminhos secretos, as bibliotecas escondidas, as seções proibidas. Seus olhos não piscam. Eles ainda falam meu nome? Ou o riscaram dos registros, fingindo que nunca existi?

trans-unit.source: The fortress of the Blood Dragons stands proud in its mountain fastness, a monument to martial honor among the damned. Idrinth regards it with something approaching respect. "Abhorash's legacy. Vampires who seek to overcome their curse through perfection of arms." He touches his own blade. "I understand the impulse. To be something more than a monster, even when the monster is what you are."
trans-unit.target: A fortaleza dos Dragões de Sangue ergue-se orgulhosa em sua montanha, um monumento à honra marcial entre os condenados. Idrinth a observa com algo próximo a respeito. O legado de Abhorash. Vampiros que buscam superar sua maldição através da perfeição das armas. Ele toca sua própria lâmina. Entendo o impulso. Ser algo mais do que um monstro, mesmo quando o monstro é o que você é.

trans-unit.source: The World Tree's presence is overwhelming, and Idrinth approaches slowly, as one might approach a judging god. "The heart of all forests. The root of the world." He speaks barely above a whisper. "I hunted in your shadow once, in my living days. The wood elves tolerated my presence as kin." He looks down at his pale hands. "Do the trees remember me? Do they recoil from what walks among their roots now?"
trans-unit.target: A presença da Árvore do Mundo é avassaladora, e Idrinth se aproxima lentamente, como alguém se aproximaria de um deus julgador. O coração de todas as florestas. A raiz do mundo. Ele fala mal acima de um sussurro. Eu cacei em sua sombra uma vez, em meus dias vivos. Os elfos da floresta toleravam minha presença como parente. Ele olha para suas mãos pálidas. As árvores se lembram de mim? Elas recuam do que agora caminha entre suas raízes?

trans-unit.source: Ships rot eternally in the Galleons Graveyard, their undead crews maintaining a mockery of maritime tradition. Idrinth surveys the wreckage with distaste. "Noctilus and his lot. Vampires who abandoned all pretense of their former lives to become something... lesser." He shakes his head. "I understand the temptation. When you can live forever, why not become a pirate king? But they've forgotten what we should be fighting."
trans-unit.target: Navios apodrecem eternamente no Cemitério dos Galeões, suas tripulações mortas-vivas mantendo uma paródia de tradição marítima. Idrinth examina os destroços com desgosto. Noctilus e sua laia. Vampiros que abandonaram toda pretensão de suas vidas anteriores para se tornarem algo... menor. Ele balança a cabeça. Entendo a tentação. Quando você pode viver para sempre, por que não se tornar um rei pirata? Mas eles esqueceram o que deveríamos estar combatendo.

trans-unit.source: The pirate haven sprawls before him, lawless and dangerous—yet almost refreshingly honest about it. "A city where the dead and living trade side by side, united by greed," Idrinth observes. "I find myself oddly comfortable here. No one pretends I am not what I am. No one demands I perform humanity I no longer possess." He pauses. "Perhaps that is why I should leave quickly."
trans-unit.target: O refúgio pirata se estende diante dele, sem lei e perigoso—mas quase refrescantemente honesto sobre isso. Uma cidade onde mortos e vivos comerciam lado a lado, unidos pela ganância, Idrinth observa. Acho-me estranhamente confortável aqui. Ninguém finge que não sou o que sou. Ninguém exige que eu represente uma humanidade que não possuo mais. Ele pausa. Talvez seja por isso que devo partir rapidamente.

trans-unit.source: The ruins of Lahmia whisper of ancient glory and the first vampires. Idrinth walks through the empty streets with something approaching reverence. "Where it all began. Neferata and her court, the first to drink from Nagash's poisoned cup." He kneels beside a toppled statue. "I have studied the histories. The first vampires were scholars, queens, warriors of great refinement. Look at what their legacy became. Look at what I became."
trans-unit.target: As ruínas de Lahmia sussurram sobre glória antiga e os primeiros vampiros. Idrinth caminha pelas ruas vazias com algo próximo a reverência. Onde tudo começou. Neferata e sua corte, os primeiros a beber do cálice envenenado de Nagash. Ele se ajoelha ao lado de uma estátua tombada. Estudei as histórias. Os primeiros vampiros eram estudiosos, rainhas, guerreiros de grande refinamento. Veja o que seu legado se tornou. Veja o que eu me tornei.

trans-unit.source: The North Tower of the Sorceresses looms dark against the northern sky, Morathi's power palpable even at a distance. Idrinth's jaw tightens. "The mother of the Witch King. The one who brought Chaos-worship to elvenkind." His voice carries cold hatred. "I have killed many servants of the Dark Powers. But this one... this one would be worth any cost." He does not approach. Not yet. "Patience. Vengeance is eternal. I have time."
trans-unit.target: A Torre Norte das Feiticeiras ergue-se sombria contra o céu do norte, o poder de Morathi palpável mesmo à distância. O maxilar de Idrinth se contrai. A mãe do Rei Bruxo. Aquela que trouxe a adoração ao Caos para a raça élfica. Sua voz carrega ódio frio. Matei muitos servos dos Poderes Sombrios. Mas esta... esta valeria qualquer custo. Ele não se aproxima. Ainda não. Paciência. A vingança é eterna. Tenho tempo.

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: O estranho remove seu manto de viagem com graça praticada, revelando armadura élfica por baixo. Servi ao lado de cavaleiros antes, ele diz, inclinando a cabeça com precisão cortês. Honra e dever transcendem as fronteiras de raça. Sua Dama protege estas terras, e eu as veria defendidas da escuridão que consome tudo. Suas feições pálidas permanecem compostas, embora seus lábios sem sangue não revelem calor. Cavalgemos contra nosso inimigo comum.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: O estranho puxa seu capuz para trás, revelando feições inconfundivelmente Asur—contudo seus olhos não carregam o desdém típico. Primo, ele diz, a palavra não carregando nem zombaria nem calor. Não me importo com rancores antigos. O Caos devora Druchii e Asur igualmente, e aprendi que a sobrevivência exige... flexibilidade. Um sorriso sem alegria cruza seus lábios sem sangue. Você entende pragmatismo melhor do que a maioria. Devemos colocá-lo em uso?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: A figura encapuzada se curva com formalidade inesperada, então se endireita para revelar feições élficas sob suas vestimentas de viagem. Caminhei por suas terras antes, em eras passadas, ele declara, sua voz medida e calma. A Grande Muralha detém horrores que conheço muito bem. O equilíbrio deve ser mantido contra os Poderes Ruinosos. Seus olhos sem idade estudam os oficiais de Cathay com interesse acadêmico. Ofereço conhecimento abrangendo milênios. Talvez possamos aprender um com o outro.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: O capuz do estranho cai, revelando um rosto élfico intocado pelo tempo. Sei a quem você serve, ele diz friamente, encontrando o olhar dos mortos-vivos sem pestanejar. E sei o que sou. Não precisamos fingir o contrário. Ele ajusta a espada larga em suas costas com facilidade familiar. Os inimigos de Nagash são servos do Caos. Por ora, esse alinhamento de propósito é suficiente. Seus lábios sem sangue se torcem em algo parecido com diversão sombria. O Grande Necromante coleta todas as coisas eventualmente. Eu simplesmente escolho os termos.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: O estranho se desfaz de seu manto manchado de sal, revelando feições élficas e armadura antiga por baixo. Naveguei mares mais escuros do que estes, ele comenta, observando a tripulação cambaleante sem nojo. Sangue é sangue, seja tomado em terra ou água. Ele produz sua bolsa de pagamento, pesando-a pensativamente. Vocês caçam, saqueiam, sobrevivem. Respeito isso. Um sorriso conhecedor cruza seu rosto pálido. E suspeito que seus capitães entendam—a imortalidade muda a perspectiva de alguém sobre... tudo.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
trans-unit.target: 一个穿着长袍的陌生人在一天晚上出现，愿意以少许报酬提供帮助。你接受帮助吗？

trans-unit.source: The Stranger
trans-unit.target: 陌生人

trans-unit.source: An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
trans-unit.target: 一位精灵信使到来，寻找一个叫 Idrinth 的人。你认识的 Idrinth 一直在躲避他，也许你可以帮忙？

trans-unit.source: A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
trans-unit.target: 一位木精灵游侠来到你的营地。她说她需要找她那沾满鲜血的表亲。Idrinth 很快确认自己就是那个人，但他拒绝会面。

trans-unit.source: An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
trans-unit.target: 一位年迈的学者走近你的营地。她带着关于过去的书籍，声称为你找到了有价值的知识。

trans-unit.source: At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
trans-unit.target: 夜晚，当寒风折磨着你的卫兵时，他们抓住了一个试图潜入营地的基斯里夫人。他年轻且看起来无害，但你该怎么处置他？

trans-unit.source: One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
trans-unit.target: 一天晚上，你发现你的一个仆人被吸干血躺在 Idrinth 帐篷外。冲进去后，你发现他正在桌边看一卷古老的卷轴。

trans-unit.source: The Messeger
trans-unit.target: 信使

trans-unit.source: Blood Cousins
trans-unit.target: 血亲

trans-unit.source: Intruder!
trans-unit.target: 入侵者！

trans-unit.source: The Scholar
trans-unit.target: 学者

trans-unit.source: The Servant's End
trans-unit.target: 仆人之死

trans-unit.source: A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
trans-unit.target: 附近发现了一群矮人。你的斥候偷听到他们讲述吸血鬼战争的故事。其中提到的一个精灵听起来很像 Idrinth。

trans-unit.source: An old feud
trans-unit.target: 一段旧仇

trans-unit.source: After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次狩猎后，Idrinth 拿着一件看起来像古代精灵武器的东西走近你。他问你该将它献给哪位神灵。

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Weapon
trans-unit.target: 祝福之武器

trans-unit.source: After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: 最近一场战斗后，Idrinth 拿着一件看起来像古代精灵护甲的东西走近你。他问你该将它献给哪位神灵。

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Armour
trans-unit.target: 祝福之护甲

trans-unit.source: After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: 结束一天的旅程后，Idrinth 拿着一件看起来像古代精灵护符的东西走近你。他问你该将它献给哪位神灵。

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Talisman
trans-unit.target: 祝福之护符

trans-unit.source: Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
trans-unit.target: 启用更严格的背景设定友好性，将骑士学者 Idrinth Thalui 的招募文化限制为高等精灵、木精灵、基斯里夫、帝国和吸血鬼伯爵。选择宽松模式则还包括吸血鬼海岸、纳迦什军团、暗精灵、震旦和布列托尼亚。

trans-unit.source: Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness
trans-unit.target: 模式：严格或宽松的背景设定友好性

trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: 收下你的金币后，陌生人自我介绍为同族阿苏尔，名叫 Idrinth。脱下旅行披风后，你看到一套饱经战火的学识大师盔甲、一把配套的巨剑和一把金属弓，靠近冷峻的双眼，暗示着尚未发生的残酷。

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: 我期待与林中猎人并肩作战，表亲，这位阿苏尔用友好的语气说道，同时收拾他的报酬和旅行斗篷。"我的射术可能不如你们，但我不会拖你们后腿。"他苍白的嘴唇上浮现出一丝淡淡的笑意，随即消失。"让我们进行一场将被传颂数世纪的狩猎！"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: 收到报酬后，陌生人脱下旅行服，露出旅行袍下精灵的面容和精灵武器。"我叫 Idrinth，我与敌人战斗的时间比你们大多数人活得还长。我很乐意与部队一起练习并教导他们。"一丝淡淡的笑意浮现在他苍白的嘴唇上，随即在他永不老去的脸上消失。

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: 我曾与信仰乌里克或西格玛的战士并肩战斗和流血。我们有共同的敌人，他一边脱下旅行披风一边说，"我期待与你们一起将他们击退。为世界的美好分享我的知识。"他冷冷地看了看祈祷中的人类，然后将注意力转回将军和他的卫兵。

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: 陌生人放下兜帽，露出精灵特征。"我不是毁灭的朋友，但我们的敌人逼迫了我。"他一边将金币收入囊中一边说道，"在家人处于危险时回归他们身边是正确的，无论那个家人是谁。你同意吗？"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The black spires of Drakenhof castle pierce the perpetual gloom of Sylvania. Idrinth stands motionless before its gates, memories of the Vampire Wars flooding back unbidden. "I bled here," he whispers, "and rose again. The Von Carsteins taught me what I had become—whether I wished to learn or not." His hand rests on his sword hilt. Does he enter as a kinsman of blood, or as a reminder of what their ambition cost the world?
trans-unit.target: 德拉肯霍夫城堡的黑色尖顶刺穿西尔瓦尼亚永恒的阴霾。Idrinth 静静地站在城门前，吸血鬼战争的记忆不请自来地涌现。"我在这里流过血，"他低声说，"然后又站了起来。冯·卡斯坦家族教会了我我已经成为什么——不管我是否愿意学习。"他的手搭在剑柄上。他是作为血亲进入，还是作为对世界代价的提醒？

trans-unit.source: The Temple of Khaine rises from Naggaroth's wastes, its altars slick with fresh offerings. Idrinth feels the Murder God's gaze upon him—not with hatred, but with hungry recognition. "You know my blade's count," he murmurs to the bloody dark. "Every chaos-spawn I've ended, every daemon I've banished. Does that please you, Bloody-Handed One? Or do you merely await the day I turn it upon the innocent?"
trans-unit.target: 凯恩神殿从纳迦罗斯的荒原中升起，祭坛上满是新鲜的祭品。Idrinth 感受到谋杀之神的目光——不是带着仇恨，而是带着饥饿的认可。"你知道我的剑下有多少亡魂，"他对着血腥的黑暗低语。"我终结的每一个混沌之子，我放逐的每一个恶魔。这让你满意吗，血手神？还是你只是等待我将剑转向无辜者的那一天？"

trans-unit.source: The Sword of Khaine pulses with malevolent promise, its whispers cutting through even Idrinth's undead stillness. For a long moment, he simply stares at the Widowmaker. "Aenarion took you up to save our people and damned his line forever," he says quietly. "I was already damned when I swore my oath of vengeance. Would you make me worse, or merely... more efficient?" His fingers twitch, but do not reach.
trans-unit.target: 凯恩之剑散发着邪恶的承诺，它的低语甚至穿透了 Idrinth 亡灵般的静止。他久久地凝视着寡妇制造者。"艾纳利昂拿起你是为了拯救我们的人民，却永远诅咒了他的血脉，"他轻声说。"我立下复仇誓言时就已被诅咒。你会让我变得更糟，还是只是……更有效率？"他的手指颤抖，但没有伸出。

trans-unit.source: The sacred flames of Asuryan's temple burn eternal, and Idrinth approaches no further than the outer courtyard. "I walked these halls as a living elf," he says, his voice hollow. "I prayed here before marching to war against the undead. Now I am what I fought." He watches the flames dance. "Do you still hear me, Lord of the Phoenix? Or does my curse make my prayers into mockery?"
trans-unit.target: 阿苏里安神殿的圣火永恒燃烧，Idrinth 走到外院就不再前进。"我作为活着的精灵曾走过这些大厅，"他说，声音空洞。"我在这里祈祷，然后向亡灵进军。现在我成了我曾经对抗的东西。"他看着火焰跳动。"你还能听到我吗，凤凰之主？还是我的诅咒让我的祈祷变成了嘲讽？"

trans-unit.source: Ancient trees frame the hunting shrine, and the scent of wild places fills the air. Idrinth breathes deep—an old habit from when breath meant life. "I hunt still, Lord of the Wild," he addresses the antlered stones. "Though I am no longer part of nature's cycle. I take no prey for sustenance of the body, only for vengeance of the spirit. Does the eternal hunt have room for one such as I?"
trans-unit.target: 古老的树木环绕着狩猎神龛，空气中弥漫着荒野的气息。Idrinth 深深吸了一口气——一个当呼吸还意味着生命时的老习惯。"我仍在狩猎，荒野之主，"他对着鹿角石说。"尽管我已不再是自然循环的一部分。我不为身体的养分而捕猎，只为灵魂的复仇。永恒的狩猎是否有我这样的人的位置？"

trans-unit.source: The Shrine of Loec shifts in the corner of one's vision, never quite where it seems. Idrinth allows himself a rare, cold smile. "The Trickster God. I have learned your arts, after a fashion—shadow magic came easier to me after death than it ever did in life." He performs a mocking half-bow. "Is that your joke, Laughing One? That I dance better now that my feet are cold?"
trans-unit.target: 洛艾克神龛在视线中若隐若现，从来不在它看起来的位置。Idrinth 允许自己露出一个罕见的、冰冷的微笑。"诡计之神。我学会了你的艺术，以某种方式——死后暗影魔法对我来说比生前更容易。"他做了一个嘲弄的半鞠躬。"这是你的玩笑吗，笑神？让我的舞步在脚变冷后反而更好了？"

trans-unit.source: The marshes of Hel Fenn stretch before him, and Idrinth's expression becomes unreadable. "This is where it ended. And began." His voice carries no emotion. "I remember the mud. The blood. Mannfred's host crumbling around us. I remember thinking we had won." A long pause. "I do not remember dying. Only waking, three nights later, hungry for something I could not name."
trans-unit.target: 赫尔沼泽的沼泽地在他面前展开，Idrinth 的表情变得难以捉摸。"这是一切结束的地方。也是开始。"他的声音没有情感。"我记得泥泞。鲜血。曼弗雷德的大军在我们周围崩溃。我记得以为我们赢了。"长久的沉默。"我不记得死亡。只记得三天后醒来，渴望着一种我无法命名的东西。"

trans-unit.source: Nagash's monument looms against the desert sky, radiating power that makes Idrinth's curse writhe within him. "The father of all our damnation," he says, neither reverent nor contemptuous—merely stating fact. "Every vampire exists because you reached too far, Great Necromancer. My curse flows from your ambition." He studies the ancient stones. "I wonder—do you approve of how I use your gift? Turning death against Chaos itself?"
trans-unit.target: 纳迦什的纪念碑在沙漠天空下高耸，散发的力量让 Idrinth 体内的诅咒颤抖。"所有诅咒之父，"他说，既不崇敬也不轻蔑——只是陈述事实。"每一个吸血鬼的存在都是因为你伸手太远，大死灵法师。我的诅咒源于你的野心。"他审视着古老的石头。"我想知道——你认可我使用你的礼物的方式吗？将死亡转向混沌本身？"

trans-unit.source: The forge-shrine of Vaul radiates ancient power, and Idrinth's enchanted weapons seem to hum in response. "I carried weapons blessed at lesser forges into the Vampire Wars," he recalls. "They shattered against the undead. Now I am undead, and I carry weapons that would have slain what I became." His fingers trace his blade's edge. "There is poetry in that, of the sort only the Maker would appreciate."
trans-unit.target: 瓦乌尔的锻造神龛散发着古老的力量，Idrinth 的附魔武器似乎在回应中嗡鸣。"我曾带着在次等锻造中祝福的武器进入吸血鬼战争，"他回忆道。"它们在亡灵面前碎裂。现在我是亡灵，我携带的武器本可以杀死我已成为的东西。"他的手指抚过剑刃。"这其中有诗意，只有锻造之神才能欣赏的那种。"

trans-unit.source: The Dark Elves claim their own connection to the Smith God, their forges burning with bitter industry. Idrinth observes without approaching. "Cousins," he muses. "They fell to one darkness, I to another. Yet they chose their path. I wonder sometimes if that makes them more honest than I—they embraced what they became, while I still pretend I am what I was."
trans-unit.target: 暗精灵声称与锻造之神有着他们自己的联系，他们的锻炉燃烧着苦涩的工业之火。Idrinth 观察但不靠近。"表亲们，"他沉思。"他们堕入一种黑暗，我堕入另一种。然而他们选择了自己的道路。我有时想知道这是否让他们比我更诚实——他们拥抱了自己成为的东西，而我仍假装我还是曾经的我。"

trans-unit.source: The Wood Elves maintain Vaul's teachings in their own way, shaping living wood alongside dead metal. Idrinth watches the craftwork with scholarly interest. "Life and death married in a single weapon," he observes. "The Asrai understand something the other kindreds do not—that the boundary is more... permeable than we like to believe." A ghost of his old academic fascination surfaces. "I should study their techniques."
trans-unit.target: 木精灵以自己的方式保持着瓦乌尔的教导，将活木与死金属一同塑造。Idrinth 以学者的兴趣观察着工艺。"生与死在一件武器中结合，"他观察道。"阿萨莱懂得其他族群不懂的东西——边界比我们愿意相信的更……可渗透。"他旧日学术热情的幽灵浮现。"我应该研究他们的技术。"

trans-unit.source: The White Tower rises impossibly high, repository of all High Elven knowledge. Idrinth stops at the base, unable—or unwilling—to enter. "I was a Loremaster," he says, voice cracking with ancient grief. "I studied within those halls. I knew the secret ways, the hidden libraries, the forbidden sections." His eyes do not blink. "Do they still speak my name? Or have they struck it from the records, pretending I never existed?"
trans-unit.target: 白塔高耸入云，是所有高等精灵知识的宝库。Idrinth 停在塔底，无法——或不愿——进入。"我曾是一位学识大师，"他说，声音因古老的悲伤而颤抖。"我曾在那些大厅里学习。我知道秘密通道、隐藏图书馆、禁区。"他的眼睛不眨。"他们还提起我的名字吗？还是他们已将它从记录中抹去，假装我从未存在过？"

trans-unit.source: The fortress of the Blood Dragons stands proud in its mountain fastness, a monument to martial honor among the damned. Idrinth regards it with something approaching respect. "Abhorash's legacy. Vampires who seek to overcome their curse through perfection of arms." He touches his own blade. "I understand the impulse. To be something more than a monster, even when the monster is what you are."
trans-unit.target: 血龙骑士团的堡垒骄傲地矗立在山间要塞，是被诅咒者中武道荣誉的纪念碑。Idrinth 以近乎尊敬的目光注视着它。"阿布霍拉什的遗产。寻求通过武艺完美来克服诅咒的吸血鬼。"他抚摸着自己的剑。"我理解这种冲动。成为超越怪物的存在，即使怪物就是你的本质。"

trans-unit.source: The World Tree's presence is overwhelming, and Idrinth approaches slowly, as one might approach a judging god. "The heart of all forests. The root of the world." He speaks barely above a whisper. "I hunted in your shadow once, in my living days. The wood elves tolerated my presence as kin." He looks down at his pale hands. "Do the trees remember me? Do they recoil from what walks among their roots now?"
trans-unit.target: 世界之树的存在是压倒性的，Idrinth 缓缓靠近，如同接近一位审判的神明。"所有森林之心。世界之根。"他的声音低于耳语。"我活着的时候曾在你的阴影下狩猎。木精灵容忍我的存在，视我为亲族。"他低头看着自己苍白的双手。"树木还记得我吗？它们会因现在在它们根下行走的东西而退缩吗？"

trans-unit.source: Ships rot eternally in the Galleons Graveyard, their undead crews maintaining a mockery of maritime tradition. Idrinth surveys the wreckage with distaste. "Noctilus and his lot. Vampires who abandoned all pretense of their former lives to become something... lesser." He shakes his head. "I understand the temptation. When you can live forever, why not become a pirate king? But they've forgotten what we should be fighting."
trans-unit.target: 船只在帆船墓地永恒地腐烂，它们的亡灵船员维持着海上传统的嘲讽。Idrinth 带着厌恶审视着残骸。"诺克提勒斯和他的同类。放弃所有对前世的伪装，成为……更低级东西的吸血鬼。"他摇摇头。"我理解这种诱惑。当你能永生时，为什么不成为海盗王？但他们忘记了我们应该为之战斗的东西。"

trans-unit.source: The pirate haven sprawls before him, lawless and dangerous—yet almost refreshingly honest about it. "A city where the dead and living trade side by side, united by greed," Idrinth observes. "I find myself oddly comfortable here. No one pretends I am not what I am. No one demands I perform humanity I no longer possess." He pauses. "Perhaps that is why I should leave quickly."
trans-unit.target: 海盗避风港在他面前蔓延，无法无天却近乎坦诚地危险。"一座死者与活人并肩交易、被贪婪团结的城市，"Idrinth 观察道。"我发现自己在这里出奇地舒适。没有人假装我不是我所是的。没有人要求我表演我不再拥有的人性。"他停顿了。"也许这就是我应该尽快离开的原因。"

trans-unit.source: The ruins of Lahmia whisper of ancient glory and the first vampires. Idrinth walks through the empty streets with something approaching reverence. "Where it all began. Neferata and her court, the first to drink from Nagash's poisoned cup." He kneels beside a toppled statue. "I have studied the histories. The first vampires were scholars, queens, warriors of great refinement. Look at what their legacy became. Look at what I became."
trans-unit.target: 拉米亚的废墟低语着古老的辉煌和最初的吸血鬼。Idrinth 怀着近乎虔诚的心情走过空旷的街道。"一切开始的地方。娜菲拉塔和她的宫廷，第一批从纳迦什的毒杯中饮下的人。"他跪在一座倒塌的雕像旁。"我研究过历史。最初的吸血鬼是学者、女王、精致的战士。看看他们的遗产变成了什么。看看我变成了什么。"

trans-unit.source: The North Tower of the Sorceresses looms dark against the northern sky, Morathi's power palpable even at a distance. Idrinth's jaw tightens. "The mother of the Witch King. The one who brought Chaos-worship to elvenkind." His voice carries cold hatred. "I have killed many servants of the Dark Powers. But this one... this one would be worth any cost." He does not approach. Not yet. "Patience. Vengeance is eternal. I have time."
trans-unit.target: 女巫之塔在北方天空下黑暗耸立，莫拉斯的力量远在咫尺都能感受到。Idrinth 的下巴绷紧。"巫王之母。将混沌崇拜带给精灵的人。"他的声音带着冰冷的仇恨。"我杀死了许多黑暗力量的仆从。但这一个……这一个值得付出任何代价。"他没有靠近。还不是时候。"耐心。复仇是永恒的。我有的是时间。"

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: 陌生人以优雅的动作脱下旅行斗篷，露出下面的精灵盔甲。"我曾与骑士并肩作战，"他说着，以宫廷礼仪微微点头。"荣誉和责任超越种族界限。你们的湖女守护着这片土地，而我愿意看到它们免受吞噬一切的黑暗。"他苍白的面容保持镇定，尽管他苍白的嘴唇没有流露出温暖。"让我们骑马对抗共同的敌人。"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: 陌生人拉下兜帽，露出明显的阿苏尔特征——但他的眼中没有他们典型的蔑视。"表亲，"他说道，这个词既不带嘲讽也不带温暖。"我不在乎古老的仇恨。混沌吞噬德鲁奇和阿苏尔，而我已经学会生存需要……灵活。"一丝冷笑浮现在他苍白的嘴唇上。"你比大多数人更懂务实。我们何不将它付诸实践？"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: 披着袍子的身影以意外的礼节鞠躬，然后直起身来，露出旅行服下的精灵特征。"我曾在远古时代走过你们的土地，"他说，声音沉稳平静。"巨龙长城阻挡着我深知的恐怖。必须维持与毁灭之力的平衡。"他永不老去的眼睛以学者的兴趣审视着震旦官员。"我提供跨越千年的知识。也许我们可以互相学习。"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: 陌生人的兜帽落下，露出一张不受时间影响的精灵面孔。"我知道你侍奉谁，"他平静地说，毫不畏惧地直视亡灵的目光。"我也知道我是什么。我们无需假装。"他熟练地调整着背上的巨剑。"纳迦什的敌人就是混沌的仆从。目前，这种目标一致就足够了。"他苍白的嘴唇扭曲成类似黑色幽默的表情。"大死灵法师终将收集一切。我只是选择了条件。"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: 陌生人脱下沾满盐渍的斗篷，露出精灵特征和下面的古老盔甲。"我航行过比这更黑暗的海域，"他说着，不带厌恶地打量着蹒跚的船员。"血就是血，无论是在陆地上还是水上。"他掏出钱袋，若有所思地掂量着。"你们狩猎、劫掠、求生。我尊重这一点。"他苍白的脸上浮现出会心的微笑。"而且我想你们的船长们明白——永生改变了一个人对……一切的看法。"

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
trans-unit.target: Jedné noci se objeví zahalený cizinec a nabízí svou pomoc za malý poplatek. Přijmeš jeho pomoc?

trans-unit.source: The Stranger
trans-unit.target: Cizinec

trans-unit.source: An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
trans-unit.target: Přichází elfí posel, hledající jakéhosi Idrintha. Idrinth, kterého znáš, se mu zatím vyhýbal, možná bys mohl pomoci?

trans-unit.source: A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
trans-unit.target: Lesní elfí stopař přichází do tvého tábora. Prohlašuje, že potřebuje svého zakrváceného bratrance. Zatímco Idrinth rychle potvrzuje, že myslel jeho, odmítá se setkat.

trans-unit.source: An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
trans-unit.target: Stará učenkyně přichází do tvého tábora. Nese knihy z minulosti a tvrdí, že pro tebe našla cenné znalosti.

trans-unit.source: At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
trans-unit.target: V noci, zatímco ledový vítr trápí tvé stráže, chytí kislevského mladíka, jak se snaží vplížit do tábora. Je mladý a zdánlivě neškodný, ale co s ním uděláš?

trans-unit.source: One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
trans-unit.target: Jedné noci najdeš jednoho ze svých služebníků vysátého z krve přímo před Idrinthovým stanem. Když vběhneš dovnitř, najdeš ho, jak sedí u stolu a čte starý svitek.

trans-unit.source: The Messeger
trans-unit.target: Posel

trans-unit.source: Blood Cousins
trans-unit.target: Krvavé bratrstvo

trans-unit.source: Intruder!
trans-unit.target: Vetřelec!

trans-unit.source: The Scholar
trans-unit.target: Učenkyně

trans-unit.source: The Servant's End
trans-unit.target: Konec služebníka

trans-unit.source: A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
trans-unit.target: V blízkosti byla spatřena skupina trpaslíků. Tvoji zvědové odposlouchali jejich příběhy o válkách s upíry. Jeden zmíněný elf podezřele připomíná Idrintha.

trans-unit.source: An old feud
trans-unit.target: Stará nevraživost

trans-unit.source: After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Po posledním lovu za tebou Idrinth přichází s něčím, co vypadá jako prastará elfí zbraň. Ptá se tě o radu, komu ji zasvětit.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Weapon
trans-unit.target: Požehnaná zbraň

trans-unit.source: After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Po poslední bitvě za tebou Idrinth přichází s něčím, co vypadá jako prastarý elfí pancíř. Ptá se tě o radu, komu ho zasvětit.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Armour
trans-unit.target: Požehnaná zbroj

trans-unit.source: After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Po ukončení denního pochodu za tebou Idrinth přichází s něčím, co vypadá jako prastarý elfí talisman. Ptá se tě o radu, komu ho zasvětit.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Talisman
trans-unit.target: Požehnaný talisman

trans-unit.source: Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
trans-unit.target: Aktivuj přísnější věrnost lore, abys omezil verbovací kultury pro Rytíře-Učence Idrintha Thaluiho na Vysoké elfy, Lesní elfy, Kislev, Říši a Vampírská hrabata. Zvol volnější mód, aby byli na seznamu také Vampírské pobřeží, Legie Nagashe, Temní elfové, Cathay a Bretonnie.

trans-unit.source: Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness
trans-unit.target: Mód: Přísnější nebo volnější věrnost lore

trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: Po přijetí tvé mince se cizinec představí jako bratr Asur jménem Idrinth. Když si sundá cestovní roucha, vidíš bitvami opotřebovanou zbroj mistra znalostí, odpovídající obouručný meč a kovový luk poblíž stoických očí naznačujících brutalitu, která teprve přijde.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: Těším se na boj po boku lovců lesů, bratranče, prohlašuje Asur přátelským tónem, zatímco balí svou platbu a cestovní plášť. Možná nejsem tak skvělý střelec jako vy, ale nezpomalím vás. Lehce pobavený úsměv hraje kolem jeho bezkrevných rtů, než zmizí. Vydejme se na lov, o kterém se bude vyprávět ještě po staletí!

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: Cizinec se svlékne poté, co byl zaplacen, a odhalí elfí tvář a elfí zbraně pod cestovním rouchem. Jmenuji se Idrinth, bojuji proti našim nepřátelům déle, než většina z vás žije. Rád bych cvičil s armádou a učil ji. Lehký úsměv hraje kolem jeho bezkrevných rtů, než zmizí v bezčasové tváři.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: Bojoval a krvácel jsem s válečníky věřícími v Ulrika nebo Sigmara. Máme stejné nepřátele, prohlašuje, zatímco si sundává cestovní roucha, a těším se, že je s vámi zatlačíme zpět. Sdílím své znalosti pro zlepšení světa. Jeho oči se chladně dívají na modlící se lidi, než vrátí svou pozornost generálovi a jeho stráži.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: Cizinec shodí kapuci a odhalí elfí rysy. Nejsem přítelem zkázy, ale naši nepřátelé mě donutili. Schovává své mince a prohlašuje: Vrátit se k rodině po mnoha letech, když je v nebezpečí, je správné, bez ohledu na to, kdo ta rodina je. Nesouhlasíš?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: Do you want to enable the Thaluian Chapels for your campaign? They offer further defenses and options compared to just having the hero.
trans-unit.target: Chceš povolit Thaluiánské kaple pro svou kampaň? Nabízejí další obranu a možnosti ve srovnání s pouhým hrdinou.

trans-unit.source: To recruit Idrinth Thalui, the Knight-Scholar, you will need to have a general with a minimum level. How early do you want to be able to recruit him?
trans-unit.target: Pro naverbování Idrintha Thaluiho, Rytíře-Učence, budeš potřebovat generála s minimální úrovní. Jak brzy chceš mít možnost ho naverbovat?

trans-unit.source: Story Events
trans-unit.target: Příběhové události

trans-unit.source: Do you want to enable story events when Idrinth reaches specific, important places?
trans-unit.target: Chceš povolit příběhové události, když Idrinth dosáhne konkrétních důležitých míst?

trans-unit.source: The Thaluian Chapels
trans-unit.target: Thaluiánské kaple

trans-unit.source: Rank of Renown
trans-unit.target: Hodnost proslulosti

trans-unit.source: Drakenhof
trans-unit.target: Drakenhof

trans-unit.source: Temple of Khaine
trans-unit.target: Chrám Khaina

trans-unit.source: Shrine of Khaine
trans-unit.target: Svatyně Khaina
