trans-unit.source: The black spires of Drakenhof castle pierce the perpetual gloom of Sylvania. Idrinth stands motionless before its gates, memories of the Vampire Wars flooding back unbidden. "I bled here," he whispers, "and rose again. The Von Carsteins taught me what I had become—whether I wished to learn or not." His hand rests on his sword hilt. Does he enter as a kinsman of blood, or as a reminder of what their ambition cost the world?
trans-unit.target: Las agujas negras del castillo de Drakenhof perforan la penumbra perpetua de Sylvania. Idrinth permanece inmóvil ante sus puertas, con recuerdos de las Guerras Vampíricas inundándolo sin ser invocados. Sangré aquí, susurra, y resurgí. Los Von Carstein me enseñaron en qué me había convertido—quisiera aprenderlo o no. Su mano descansa en la empuñadura de su espada. ¿Entra como pariente de sangre, o como recordatorio de lo que su ambición le costó al mundo?

trans-unit.source: The Temple of Khaine rises from Naggaroth's wastes, its altars slick with fresh offerings. Idrinth feels the Murder God's gaze upon him—not with hatred, but with hungry recognition. "You know my blade's count," he murmurs to the bloody dark. "Every chaos-spawn I've ended, every daemon I've banished. Does that please you, Bloody-Handed One? Or do you merely await the day I turn it upon the innocent?"
trans-unit.target: El Templo de Khaine se eleva desde los páramos de Naggaroth, sus altares resbaladizos con ofrendas frescas. Idrinth siente la mirada del Dios del Asesinato sobre él—no con odio, sino con reconocimiento hambriento. Conoces la cuenta de mi espada, murmura a la oscuridad sangrienta. Cada engendro del caos que he acabado, cada demonio que he desterrado. ¿Eso te complace, Manos Sangrientas? ¿O simplemente esperas el día en que la vuelva contra los inocentes?

trans-unit.source: The Sword of Khaine pulses with malevolent promise, its whispers cutting through even Idrinth's undead stillness. For a long moment, he simply stares at the Widowmaker. "Aenarion took you up to save our people and damned his line forever," he says quietly. "I was already damned when I swore my oath of vengeance. Would you make me worse, or merely... more efficient?" His fingers twitch, but do not reach.
trans-unit.target: La Espada de Khaine pulsa con promesa malévola, sus susurros cortando incluso la quietud no-muerta de Idrinth. Durante un largo momento, simplemente mira a la Hacedora de Viudas. Aenarion te tomó para salvar a nuestro pueblo y condenó a su linaje para siempre, dice en voz baja. Yo ya estaba condenado cuando juré mi juramento de venganza. ¿Me harías peor, o simplemente... más eficiente? Sus dedos se mueven, pero no alcanzan.

trans-unit.source: The sacred flames of Asuryan's temple burn eternal, and Idrinth approaches no further than the outer courtyard. "I walked these halls as a living elf," he says, his voice hollow. "I prayed here before marching to war against the undead. Now I am what I fought." He watches the flames dance. "Do you still hear me, Lord of the Phoenix? Or does my curse make my prayers into mockery?"
trans-unit.target: Las llamas sagradas del templo de Asuryan arden eternamente, e Idrinth no se acerca más allá del patio exterior. Caminé por estos pasillos como un elfo vivo, dice, su voz vacía. Recé aquí antes de marchar a la guerra contra los no-muertos. Ahora soy lo que combatí. Observa las llamas danzar. ¿Todavía me escuchas, Señor del Fénix? ¿O mi maldición convierte mis oraciones en burla?

trans-unit.source: Ancient trees frame the hunting shrine, and the scent of wild places fills the air. Idrinth breathes deep—an old habit from when breath meant life. "I hunt still, Lord of the Wild," he addresses the antlered stones. "Though I am no longer part of nature's cycle. I take no prey for sustenance of the body, only for vengeance of the spirit. Does the eternal hunt have room for one such as I?"
trans-unit.target: Árboles antiguos enmarcan el santuario de caza, y el aroma de lugares salvajes llena el aire. Idrinth respira profundamente—un viejo hábito de cuando respirar significaba vida. Todavía cazo, Señor de lo Salvaje, se dirige a las piedras con astas. Aunque ya no soy parte del ciclo de la naturaleza. No tomo presas para sustento del cuerpo, solo para venganza del espíritu. ¿La caza eterna tiene lugar para alguien como yo?

trans-unit.source: The Shrine of Loec shifts in the corner of one's vision, never quite where it seems. Idrinth allows himself a rare, cold smile. "The Trickster God. I have learned your arts, after a fashion—shadow magic came easier to me after death than it ever did in life." He performs a mocking half-bow. "Is that your joke, Laughing One? That I dance better now that my feet are cold?"
trans-unit.target: El Santuario de Loec se desplaza en el rabillo del ojo, nunca exactamente donde parece. Idrinth se permite una rara y fría sonrisa. El Dios Embaucador. He aprendido tus artes, de cierta manera—la magia de las sombras me llegó más fácil después de la muerte que en vida. Hace una media reverencia burlona. ¿Es esa tu broma, Risueño? ¿Que bailo mejor ahora que mis pies están fríos?

trans-unit.source: The marshes of Hel Fenn stretch before him, and Idrinth's expression becomes unreadable. "This is where it ended. And began." His voice carries no emotion. "I remember the mud. The blood. Mannfred's host crumbling around us. I remember thinking we had won." A long pause. "I do not remember dying. Only waking, three nights later, hungry for something I could not name."
trans-unit.target: Las marismas de Hel Fenn se extienden ante él, y la expresión de Idrinth se vuelve indescifrable. Aquí es donde terminó. Y comenzó. Su voz no lleva emoción. Recuerdo el barro. La sangre. La hueste de Mannfred desmoronándose a nuestro alrededor. Recuerdo pensar que habíamos ganado. Una larga pausa. No recuerdo morir. Solo despertar, tres noches después, hambriento de algo que no podía nombrar.

trans-unit.source: Nagash's monument looms against the desert sky, radiating power that makes Idrinth's curse writhe within him. "The father of all our damnation," he says, neither reverent nor contemptuous—merely stating fact. "Every vampire exists because you reached too far, Great Necromancer. My curse flows from your ambition." He studies the ancient stones. "I wonder—do you approve of how I use your gift? Turning death against Chaos itself?"
trans-unit.target: El monumento de Nagash se eleva contra el cielo del desierto, irradiando un poder que hace retorcerse a la maldición de Idrinth dentro de él. El padre de toda nuestra condenación, dice, ni reverente ni despectivo—simplemente declarando un hecho. Cada vampiro existe porque alcanzaste demasiado lejos, Gran Nigromante. Mi maldición fluye de tu ambición. Estudia las piedras antiguas. Me pregunto—¿apruebas cómo uso tu don? ¿Volviendo la muerte contra el Caos mismo?

trans-unit.source: The forge-shrine of Vaul radiates ancient power, and Idrinth's enchanted weapons seem to hum in response. "I carried weapons blessed at lesser forges into the Vampire Wars," he recalls. "They shattered against the undead. Now I am undead, and I carry weapons that would have slain what I became." His fingers trace his blade's edge. "There is poetry in that, of the sort only the Maker would appreciate."
trans-unit.target: El santuario-forja de Vaul irradia poder antiguo, y las armas encantadas de Idrinth parecen zumbar en respuesta. Llevé armas bendecidas en forjas menores a las Guerras Vampíricas, recuerda. Se rompieron contra los no-muertos. Ahora soy no-muerto, y llevo armas que habrían matado en lo que me convertí. Sus dedos trazan el filo de su espada. Hay poesía en eso, del tipo que solo el Hacedor apreciaría.

trans-unit.source: The Dark Elves claim their own connection to the Smith God, their forges burning with bitter industry. Idrinth observes without approaching. "Cousins," he muses. "They fell to one darkness, I to another. Yet they chose their path. I wonder sometimes if that makes them more honest than I—they embraced what they became, while I still pretend I am what I was."
trans-unit.target: Los Elfos Oscuros reclaman su propia conexión con el Dios Herrero, sus forjas ardiendo con amarga industria. Idrinth observa sin acercarse. Primos, reflexiona. Ellos cayeron en una oscuridad, yo en otra. Sin embargo ellos eligieron su camino. A veces me pregunto si eso los hace más honestos que yo—ellos abrazaron en lo que se convirtieron, mientras yo todavía pretendo ser lo que fui.

trans-unit.source: The Wood Elves maintain Vaul's teachings in their own way, shaping living wood alongside dead metal. Idrinth watches the craftwork with scholarly interest. "Life and death married in a single weapon," he observes. "The Asrai understand something the other kindreds do not—that the boundary is more... permeable than we like to believe." A ghost of his old academic fascination surfaces. "I should study their techniques."
trans-unit.target: Los Elfos Silvanos mantienen las enseñanzas de Vaul a su manera, dando forma a madera viva junto al metal muerto. Idrinth observa el trabajo artesanal con interés erudito. Vida y muerte casadas en una sola arma, observa. Los Asrai entienden algo que los otros linajes no—que la frontera es más... permeable de lo que nos gusta creer. Un fantasma de su antigua fascinación académica sale a la superficie. Debería estudiar sus técnicas.

trans-unit.source: The White Tower rises impossibly high, repository of all High Elven knowledge. Idrinth stops at the base, unable—or unwilling—to enter. "I was a Loremaster," he says, voice cracking with ancient grief. "I studied within those halls. I knew the secret ways, the hidden libraries, the forbidden sections." His eyes do not blink. "Do they still speak my name? Or have they struck it from the records, pretending I never existed?"
trans-unit.target: La Torre Blanca se eleva imposiblemente alta, repositorio de todo el conocimiento Alto Élfico. Idrinth se detiene en la base, incapaz—o sin querer—de entrar. Fui un Maestro del Saber, dice, con la voz quebrándose de antigua pena. Estudié dentro de esos pasillos. Conocía los caminos secretos, las bibliotecas ocultas, las secciones prohibidas. Sus ojos no parpadean. ¿Todavía hablan mi nombre? ¿O lo han borrado de los registros, pretendiendo que nunca existí?

trans-unit.source: The fortress of the Blood Dragons stands proud in its mountain fastness, a monument to martial honor among the damned. Idrinth regards it with something approaching respect. "Abhorash's legacy. Vampires who seek to overcome their curse through perfection of arms." He touches his own blade. "I understand the impulse. To be something more than a monster, even when the monster is what you are."
trans-unit.target: La fortaleza de los Dragones de Sangre se alza orgullosa en su bastión montañoso, un monumento al honor marcial entre los condenados. Idrinth la contempla con algo parecido al respeto. El legado de Abhorash. Vampiros que buscan superar su maldición a través de la perfección de las armas. Toca su propia espada. Entiendo el impulso. Ser algo más que un monstruo, incluso cuando el monstruo es lo que eres.

trans-unit.source: The World Tree's presence is overwhelming, and Idrinth approaches slowly, as one might approach a judging god. "The heart of all forests. The root of the world." He speaks barely above a whisper. "I hunted in your shadow once, in my living days. The wood elves tolerated my presence as kin." He looks down at his pale hands. "Do the trees remember me? Do they recoil from what walks among their roots now?"
trans-unit.target: La presencia del Árbol del Mundo es abrumadora, e Idrinth se acerca lentamente, como uno podría acercarse a un dios que juzga. El corazón de todos los bosques. La raíz del mundo. Habla apenas por encima de un susurro. Cacé en tu sombra una vez, en mis días de vida. Los elfos silvanos toleraban mi presencia como pariente. Mira hacia abajo a sus manos pálidas. ¿Me recuerdan los árboles? ¿Se retraen de lo que ahora camina entre sus raíces?

trans-unit.source: Ships rot eternally in the Galleons Graveyard, their undead crews maintaining a mockery of maritime tradition. Idrinth surveys the wreckage with distaste. "Noctilus and his lot. Vampires who abandoned all pretense of their former lives to become something... lesser." He shakes his head. "I understand the temptation. When you can live forever, why not become a pirate king? But they've forgotten what we should be fighting."
trans-unit.target: Los barcos se pudren eternamente en el Cementerio de Galeones, sus tripulaciones no-muertas manteniendo una burla de tradición marítima. Idrinth examina los restos con disgusto. Noctilus y los suyos. Vampiros que abandonaron toda pretensión de sus vidas anteriores para convertirse en algo... menor. Sacude la cabeza. Entiendo la tentación. Cuando puedes vivir para siempre, ¿por qué no convertirse en un rey pirata? Pero han olvidado contra qué deberíamos estar luchando.

trans-unit.source: The pirate haven sprawls before him, lawless and dangerous—yet almost refreshingly honest about it. "A city where the dead and living trade side by side, united by greed," Idrinth observes. "I find myself oddly comfortable here. No one pretends I am not what I am. No one demands I perform humanity I no longer possess." He pauses. "Perhaps that is why I should leave quickly."
trans-unit.target: El refugio pirata se extiende ante él, sin ley y peligroso—pero casi refrescantemente honesto al respecto. Una ciudad donde los muertos y los vivos comercian lado a lado, unidos por la codicia, observa Idrinth. Me encuentro extrañamente cómodo aquí. Nadie pretende que no soy lo que soy. Nadie exige que represente la humanidad que ya no poseo. Hace una pausa. Quizás por eso debería irme rápidamente.

trans-unit.source: The ruins of Lahmia whisper of ancient glory and the first vampires. Idrinth walks through the empty streets with something approaching reverence. "Where it all began. Neferata and her court, the first to drink from Nagash's poisoned cup." He kneels beside a toppled statue. "I have studied the histories. The first vampires were scholars, queens, warriors of great refinement. Look at what their legacy became. Look at what I became."
trans-unit.target: Las ruinas de Lahmia susurran de antigua gloria y los primeros vampiros. Idrinth camina por las calles vacías con algo parecido a la reverencia. Donde todo comenzó. Neferata y su corte, los primeros en beber de la copa envenenada de Nagash. Se arrodilla junto a una estatua derribada. He estudiado las historias. Los primeros vampiros eran eruditos, reinas, guerreros de gran refinamiento. Mira en qué se convirtió su legado. Mira en qué me convertí yo.

trans-unit.source: The North Tower of the Sorceresses looms dark against the northern sky, Morathi's power palpable even at a distance. Idrinth's jaw tightens. "The mother of the Witch King. The one who brought Chaos-worship to elvenkind." His voice carries cold hatred. "I have killed many servants of the Dark Powers. But this one... this one would be worth any cost." He does not approach. Not yet. "Patience. Vengeance is eternal. I have time."
trans-unit.target: La Torre del Norte de las Hechiceras se eleva oscura contra el cielo septentrional, el poder de Morathi palpable incluso a distancia. La mandíbula de Idrinth se tensa. La madre del Rey Brujo. La que trajo la adoración del Caos a la raza élfica. Su voz lleva frío odio. He matado a muchos siervos de los Poderes Oscuros. Pero esta... esta valdría cualquier costo. No se acerca. Todavía no. Paciencia. La venganza es eterna. Tengo tiempo.

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: El extraño se quita su capa de viaje con gracia practicada, revelando armadura élfica debajo. He servido junto a caballeros antes, dice, inclinando la cabeza con precisión cortesana. El honor y el deber trascienden las fronteras de la raza. Tu Dama protege estas tierras, y yo las vería defendidas de la oscuridad que todo lo consume. Sus rasgos pálidos permanecen compuestos, aunque sus labios exangües no traicionan calidez. Cabalgamos contra nuestro enemigo común.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: El extraño retira su capucha, revelando rasgos inconfundiblemente Asur—pero sus ojos no guardan nada de su típico desdén. Primo, dice, la palabra sin llevar ni burla ni calidez. No me importan los antiguos rencores. El Caos devora a Druchii y Asur por igual, y he aprendido que la supervivencia exige... flexibilidad. Una sonrisa sin alegría cruza sus labios exangües. Tú entiendes el pragmatismo mejor que la mayoría. ¿Lo ponemos en uso?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: La figura encapuchada se inclina con inesperada formalidad, luego se endereza para revelar rasgos élficos bajo sus prendas de viaje. He caminado por vuestras tierras antes, en eras pasadas, declara, su voz medida y calmada. La Gran Muralla contiene horrores que conozco demasiado bien. El equilibrio debe mantenerse contra los Poderes Ruinosos. Sus ojos sin edad estudian a los oficiales de Catay con interés erudito. Ofrezco conocimiento que abarca milenios. Quizás podamos aprender el uno del otro.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: La capucha del extraño cae, revelando un rostro élfico intacto por el tiempo. Sé a quién sirves, dice llanamente, encontrando la mirada de los no-muertos sin pestañear. Y sé lo que soy. No necesitamos pretender lo contrario. Ajusta el espadón en su espalda con facilidad familiar. Los enemigos de Nagash son siervos del Caos. Por ahora, esa alineación de propósito es suficiente. Sus labios exangües se tuercen en algo que se asemeja a diversión oscura. El Gran Nigromante recoge todas las cosas eventualmente. Yo simplemente elijo los términos.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: El extraño se quita su capa manchada de sal, revelando rasgos élficos y armadura antigua debajo. He navegado mares más oscuros que estos, comenta, mirando a la tripulación tambaleante sin disgusto. La sangre es sangre, ya sea tomada en tierra o agua. Produce su bolsa de pago, sopesándola pensativamente. Cazáis, saqueáis, sobrevivís. Respeto eso. Una sonrisa conocedora cruza su rostro pálido. Y sospecho que vuestros capitanes entienden—la inmortalidad cambia la perspectiva de uno sobre... todo.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
trans-unit.target: Un étranger encapuchonné apparaît une nuit, offrant son aide pour une modique somme. Acceptez-vous son aide ?

trans-unit.source: The Stranger
trans-unit.target: L'Étranger

trans-unit.source: An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
trans-unit.target: Un messager elfique arrive, cherchant un certain Idrinth. L'Idrinth que vous connaissez l'a évité jusqu'ici, peut-être pourriez-vous aider ?

trans-unit.source: A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
trans-unit.target: Une rôdeuse elfe sylvaine arrive à votre campement. Elle dit avoir besoin de son cousin ensanglanté. Bien qu'Idrinth confirme rapidement qu'il était visé, il refuse de la rencontrer.

trans-unit.source: An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
trans-unit.target: Une vieille érudite approche votre camp. Portant des livres du passé, elle prétend avoir trouvé des connaissances précieuses pour vous.

trans-unit.source: At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
trans-unit.target: La nuit, tandis qu'un vent glacial torture vos gardes, ils attrapent un Kislevite qui tente de s'infiltrer dans le camp. Il est jeune et apparemment inoffensif, mais que faites-vous de lui ?

trans-unit.source: One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
trans-unit.target: Une nuit, vous trouvez l'un de vos serviteurs vidé de son sang juste devant la tente d'Idrinth. Vous précipitant à l'intérieur, vous le trouvez assis à sa table, lisant un vieux parchemin.

trans-unit.source: The Messeger
trans-unit.target: Le Messager

trans-unit.source: Blood Cousins
trans-unit.target: Cousins de Sang

trans-unit.source: Intruder!
trans-unit.target: Intrus !

trans-unit.source: The Scholar
trans-unit.target: L'Érudite

trans-unit.source: The Servant's End
trans-unit.target: La Fin du Serviteur

trans-unit.source: A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
trans-unit.target: Un groupe de nains a été repéré à proximité. Vos éclaireurs ont écouté leurs histoires sur les guerres vampiriques. Un elfe mentionné ressemble étrangement à Idrinth.

trans-unit.source: An old feud
trans-unit.target: Une Vieille Querelle

trans-unit.source: After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Après la dernière chasse, Idrinth vous approche avec ce qui ressemble à une ancienne arme elfique. Il vous demande conseil sur à qui la dédier.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Weapon
trans-unit.target: Une Arme Bénie

trans-unit.source: After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Après la dernière bataille, Idrinth vous approche avec ce qui ressemble à une ancienne armure elfique. Il vous demande conseil sur à qui la dédier.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Armour
trans-unit.target: Une Armure Bénie

trans-unit.source: After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Après la fin du voyage du jour, Idrinth vous approche avec ce qui ressemble à un ancien talisman elfique. Il vous demande conseil sur à qui le dédier.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Talisman
trans-unit.target: Un Talisman Béni

trans-unit.source: Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
trans-unit.target: Activez une fidélité plus stricte au canon pour limiter les cultures de recrutement pour le Chevalier-Érudit Idrinth Thalui aux Hauts Elfes, Elfes Sylvains, Kislev, l'Empire et les Comtes Vampires. Choisissez le mode plus souple pour avoir également la Côte des Vampires, les Légions de Nagash, les Elfes Noirs, Cathay et la Bretonnie.

trans-unit.source: Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness
trans-unit.target: Mode : Fidélité au Canon Plus Stricte ou Plus Souple

trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: Après avoir accepté votre pièce, l'étranger se présente comme un Asur nommé Idrinth. En ôtant ses robes de voyage, vous voyez l'armure usée par les batailles d'un maître du savoir, une grande épée assortie et un arc métallique près d'yeux stoïques laissant présager des brutalités à venir.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: Je me réjouis de combattre aux côtés des chasseurs des bois, cousin, déclare l'Asur d'un ton amical tout en rangeant son paiement et sa cape de voyage. Je ne suis peut-être pas aussi bon tireur que vous, mais je ne vous ralentirai pas. Un sourire légèrement amusé joue sur ses lèvres exsangues avant de disparaître. Faisons une chasse dont on parlera encore dans les siècles à venir !

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: L'étranger se dévêt après avoir été payé et révèle un visage elfique et des armes elfiques sous ses robes de voyage. Mon nom est Idrinth, je combats nos ennemis depuis plus longtemps que la plupart d'entre vous n'ont vécu. J'aimerais m'entraîner avec la troupe et les enseigner. Un léger sourire joue sur ses lèvres exsangues avant de disparaître dans un visage sans âge.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: J'ai combattu et saigné avec des guerriers croyant en Ulfic ou Sigmar. Nous avons les mêmes ennemis, déclare-t-il en ôtant ses robes de voyage, et je me réjouis de les repousser avec vous. Partager mon savoir pour le bien du monde. Ses yeux regardent froidement les humains en prière avant de revenir sur le général et sa garde.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: L'étranger baisse sa capuche, révélant des traits elfiques. Je ne suis pas un ami de la destruction, mais nos ennemis ont forcé ma main. Empochant ses pièces, il déclare : Revenir vers sa famille après de nombreuses années quand elle est en danger est juste, peu importe qui est cette famille. N'êtes-vous pas d'accord ?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.target: Voulez-vous activer les Chapelles Thaluiennes pour votre campagne ? Elles offrent des défenses et options supplémentaires comparées au seul héros.

trans-unit.source: The black spires of Drakenhof castle pierce the perpetual gloom of Sylvania. Idrinth stands motionless before its gates, memories of the Vampire Wars flooding back unbidden. "I bled here," he whispers, "and rose again. The Von Carsteins taught me what I had become—whether I wished to learn or not." His hand rests on his sword hilt. Does he enter as a kinsman of blood, or as a reminder of what their ambition cost the world?
trans-unit.target: Les flèches noires du château de Drakenhof percent les ténèbres perpétuelles de Sylvanie. Idrinth se tient immobile devant ses portes, les souvenirs des Guerres Vampiriques affluant sans qu'il le veuille. « J'ai saigné ici », murmure-t-il, « et je me suis relevé. Les Von Carstein m'ont appris ce que j'étais devenu — que je le veuille ou non. » Sa main repose sur le pommeau de son épée. Entre-t-il en parent de sang, ou comme un rappel de ce que leur ambition a coûté au monde ?

trans-unit.source: The Temple of Khaine rises from Naggaroth's wastes, its altars slick with fresh offerings. Idrinth feels the Murder God's gaze upon him—not with hatred, but with hungry recognition. "You know my blade's count," he murmurs to the bloody dark. "Every chaos-spawn I've ended, every daemon I've banished. Does that please you, Bloody-Handed One? Or do you merely await the day I turn it upon the innocent?"
trans-unit.target: Le Temple de Khaine s'élève des terres désolées du Naggaroth, ses autels luisants d'offrandes fraîches. Idrinth sent le regard du Dieu du Meurtre sur lui — non pas avec haine, mais avec une reconnaissance avide. « Tu connais le compte de ma lame », murmure-t-il aux ténèbres sanglantes. « Chaque créature du chaos que j'ai achevée, chaque démon que j'ai banni. Cela te plaît-il, Celui aux Mains Sanglantes ? Ou attends-tu simplement le jour où je la tournerai contre les innocents ? »

trans-unit.source: The Sword of Khaine pulses with malevolent promise, its whispers cutting through even Idrinth's undead stillness. For a long moment, he simply stares at the Widowmaker. "Aenarion took you up to save our people and damned his line forever," he says quietly. "I was already damned when I swore my oath of vengeance. Would you make me worse, or merely... more efficient?" His fingers twitch, but do not reach.
trans-unit.target: L'Épée de Khaine pulse d'une promesse malveillante, ses murmures perçant même l'immobilité de mort-vivant d'Idrinth. Pendant un long moment, il fixe simplement la Faucheuse de Veuves. « Aenarion t'a prise pour sauver notre peuple et a damné sa lignée pour toujours », dit-il doucement. « J'étais déjà damné quand j'ai juré mon serment de vengeance. Me rendrais-tu pire, ou simplement... plus efficace ? » Ses doigts tressaillent, mais ne s'étendent pas.

trans-unit.source: The sacred flames of Asuryan's temple burn eternal, and Idrinth approaches no further than the outer courtyard. "I walked these halls as a living elf," he says, his voice hollow. "I prayed here before marching to war against the undead. Now I am what I fought." He watches the flames dance. "Do you still hear me, Lord of the Phoenix? Or does my curse make my prayers into mockery?"
trans-unit.target: Les flammes sacrées du temple d'Asuryan brûlent éternellement, et Idrinth n'approche pas plus loin que la cour extérieure. « J'ai marché dans ces couloirs en tant qu'elfe vivant », dit-il, la voix creuse. « J'ai prié ici avant de marcher à la guerre contre les morts-vivants. Maintenant je suis ce que j'ai combattu. » Il regarde les flammes danser. « M'entends-tu encore, Seigneur du Phénix ? Ou ma malédiction transforme-t-elle mes prières en moquerie ? »

trans-unit.source: Ancient trees frame the hunting shrine, and the scent of wild places fills the air. Idrinth breathes deep—an old habit from when breath meant life. "I hunt still, Lord of the Wild," he addresses the antlered stones. "Though I am no longer part of nature's cycle. I take no prey for sustenance of the body, only for vengeance of the spirit. Does the eternal hunt have room for one such as I?"
trans-unit.target: D'anciens arbres encadrent le sanctuaire de chasse, et le parfum des lieux sauvages emplit l'air. Idrinth respire profondément — une vieille habitude du temps où respirer signifiait vivre. « Je chasse encore, Seigneur du Sauvage », s'adresse-t-il aux pierres couronnées de bois. « Bien que je ne fasse plus partie du cycle de la nature. Je ne prends aucune proie pour nourrir le corps, seulement pour la vengeance de l'esprit. La chasse éternelle a-t-elle une place pour quelqu'un comme moi ? »

trans-unit.source: The Shrine of Loec shifts in the corner of one's vision, never quite where it seems. Idrinth allows himself a rare, cold smile. "The Trickster God. I have learned your arts, after a fashion—shadow magic came easier to me after death than it ever did in life." He performs a mocking half-bow. "Is that your joke, Laughing One? That I dance better now that my feet are cold?"
trans-unit.target: Le Sanctuaire de Loec se déplace au coin de la vision, jamais vraiment là où il semble être. Idrinth se permet un rare sourire froid. « Le Dieu Trompeur. J'ai appris tes arts, à ma façon — la magie des ombres m'est venue plus facilement après la mort que dans la vie. » Il exécute une révérence moqueuse. « Est-ce ta plaisanterie, Celui qui Rit ? Que je danse mieux maintenant que mes pieds sont froids ? »

trans-unit.source: The marshes of Hel Fenn stretch before him, and Idrinth's expression becomes unreadable. "This is where it ended. And began." His voice carries no emotion. "I remember the mud. The blood. Mannfred's host crumbling around us. I remember thinking we had won." A long pause. "I do not remember dying. Only waking, three nights later, hungry for something I could not name."
trans-unit.target: Les marais de Hel Fenn s'étendent devant lui, et l'expression d'Idrinth devient indéchiffrable. « C'est ici que cela s'est terminé. Et a commencé. » Sa voix ne porte aucune émotion. « Je me souviens de la boue. Du sang. De l'armée de Mannfred s'effondrant autour de nous. Je me souviens avoir pensé que nous avions gagné. » Une longue pause. « Je ne me souviens pas être mort. Seulement m'être réveillé, trois nuits plus tard, affamé de quelque chose que je ne pouvais nommer. »

trans-unit.source: Nagash's monument looms against the desert sky, radiating power that makes Idrinth's curse writhe within him. "The father of all our damnation," he says, neither reverent nor contemptuous—merely stating fact. "Every vampire exists because you reached too far, Great Necromancer. My curse flows from your ambition." He studies the ancient stones. "I wonder—do you approve of how I use your gift? Turning death against Chaos itself?"
trans-unit.target: Le monument de Nagash se dresse contre le ciel du désert, irradiant un pouvoir qui fait se tordre la malédiction d'Idrinth en lui. « Le père de notre damnation à tous », dit-il, ni révérencieux ni méprisant — constatant simplement un fait. « Chaque vampire existe parce que tu as voulu aller trop loin, Grand Nécromancien. Ma malédiction découle de ton ambition. » Il étudie les pierres anciennes. « Je me demande — approuves-tu comment j'utilise ton don ? Retourner la mort contre le Chaos lui-même ? »

trans-unit.source: The forge-shrine of Vaul radiates ancient power, and Idrinth's enchanted weapons seem to hum in response. "I carried weapons blessed at lesser forges into the Vampire Wars," he recalls. "They shattered against the undead. Now I am undead, and I carry weapons that would have slain what I became." His fingers trace his blade's edge. "There is poetry in that, of the sort only the Maker would appreciate."
trans-unit.target: Le sanctuaire-forge de Vaul irradie un pouvoir ancien, et les armes enchantées d'Idrinth semblent bourdonner en réponse. « J'ai porté des armes bénies dans des forges moindres aux Guerres Vampiriques », se souvient-il. « Elles se sont brisées contre les morts-vivants. Maintenant je suis mort-vivant, et je porte des armes qui auraient tué ce que je suis devenu. » Ses doigts tracent le fil de sa lame. « Il y a une poésie là-dedans, du genre que seul le Créateur apprécierait. »

trans-unit.source: The Dark Elves claim their own connection to the Smith God, their forges burning with bitter industry. Idrinth observes without approaching. "Cousins," he muses. "They fell to one darkness, I to another. Yet they chose their path. I wonder sometimes if that makes them more honest than I—they embraced what they became, while I still pretend I am what I was."
trans-unit.target: Les Elfes Noirs revendiquent leur propre connexion au Dieu Forgeron, leurs forges brûlant d'une industrie amère. Idrinth observe sans approcher. « Cousins », songe-t-il. « Ils sont tombés dans une ténèbre, moi dans une autre. Pourtant ils ont choisi leur voie. Je me demande parfois si cela les rend plus honnêtes que moi — ils ont embrassé ce qu'ils sont devenus, alors que je fais encore semblant d'être ce que j'étais. »

trans-unit.source: The Wood Elves maintain Vaul's teachings in their own way, shaping living wood alongside dead metal. Idrinth watches the craftwork with scholarly interest. "Life and death married in a single weapon," he observes. "The Asrai understand something the other kindreds do not—that the boundary is more... permeable than we like to believe." A ghost of his old academic fascination surfaces. "I should study their techniques."
trans-unit.target: Les Elfes Sylvains maintiennent les enseignements de Vaul à leur manière, façonnant le bois vivant aux côtés du métal mort. Idrinth observe l'artisanat avec un intérêt savant. « La vie et la mort mariées en une seule arme », observe-t-il. « Les Asrai comprennent quelque chose que les autres parentés ne comprennent pas — que la frontière est plus... perméable que nous aimons le croire. » Un fantôme de sa vieille fascination académique refait surface. « Je devrais étudier leurs techniques. »

trans-unit.source: The White Tower rises impossibly high, repository of all High Elven knowledge. Idrinth stops at the base, unable—or unwilling—to enter. "I was a Loremaster," he says, voice cracking with ancient grief. "I studied within those halls. I knew the secret ways, the hidden libraries, the forbidden sections." His eyes do not blink. "Do they still speak my name? Or have they struck it from the records, pretending I never existed?"
trans-unit.target: La Tour Blanche s'élève d'une hauteur impossible, dépositaire de tout le savoir des Hauts Elfes. Idrinth s'arrête à la base, incapable — ou refusant — d'entrer. « J'étais un Maître du Savoir », dit-il, la voix se brisant de chagrin ancien. « J'ai étudié dans ces halls. Je connaissais les passages secrets, les bibliothèques cachées, les sections interdites. » Ses yeux ne clignent pas. « Prononcent-ils encore mon nom ? Ou l'ont-ils rayé des registres, prétendant que je n'ai jamais existé ? »

trans-unit.source: The fortress of the Blood Dragons stands proud in its mountain fastness, a monument to martial honor among the damned. Idrinth regards it with something approaching respect. "Abhorash's legacy. Vampires who seek to overcome their curse through perfection of arms." He touches his own blade. "I understand the impulse. To be something more than a monster, even when the monster is what you are."
trans-unit.target: La forteresse des Dragons de Sang se dresse fièrement dans son refuge montagneux, un monument à l'honneur martial parmi les damnés. Idrinth la regarde avec quelque chose approchant le respect. « L'héritage d'Abhorash. Des vampires qui cherchent à surmonter leur malédiction par la perfection des armes. » Il touche sa propre lame. « Je comprends l'impulsion. Être quelque chose de plus qu'un monstre, même quand le monstre est ce que vous êtes. »

trans-unit.source: The World Tree's presence is overwhelming, and Idrinth approaches slowly, as one might approach a judging god. "The heart of all forests. The root of the world." He speaks barely above a whisper. "I hunted in your shadow once, in my living days. The wood elves tolerated my presence as kin." He looks down at his pale hands. "Do the trees remember me? Do they recoil from what walks among their roots now?"
trans-unit.target: La présence de l'Arbre du Monde est écrasante, et Idrinth approche lentement, comme on approcherait un dieu qui juge. « Le cœur de toutes les forêts. La racine du monde. » Il parle à peine au-dessus d'un murmure. « J'ai chassé dans ton ombre autrefois, du temps de mon vivant. Les elfes sylvains toléraient ma présence comme celle d'un parent. » Il regarde ses mains pâles. « Les arbres se souviennent-ils de moi ? Reculent-ils devant ce qui marche parmi leurs racines maintenant ? »

trans-unit.source: Ships rot eternally in the Galleons Graveyard, their undead crews maintaining a mockery of maritime tradition. Idrinth surveys the wreckage with distaste. "Noctilus and his lot. Vampires who abandoned all pretense of their former lives to become something... lesser." He shakes his head. "I understand the temptation. When you can live forever, why not become a pirate king? But they've forgotten what we should be fighting."
trans-unit.target: Les navires pourrissent éternellement dans le Cimetière des Galions, leurs équipages morts-vivants maintenant une parodie de tradition maritime. Idrinth examine l'épave avec dégoût. « Noctilus et sa bande. Des vampires qui ont abandonné toute prétention de leurs anciennes vies pour devenir quelque chose... de moindre. » Il secoue la tête. « Je comprends la tentation. Quand on peut vivre éternellement, pourquoi ne pas devenir un roi pirate ? Mais ils ont oublié ce que nous devrions combattre. »

trans-unit.source: The pirate haven sprawls before him, lawless and dangerous—yet almost refreshingly honest about it. "A city where the dead and living trade side by side, united by greed," Idrinth observes. "I find myself oddly comfortable here. No one pretends I am not what I am. No one demands I perform humanity I no longer possess." He pauses. "Perhaps that is why I should leave quickly."
trans-unit.target: Le havre pirate s'étend devant lui, sans loi et dangereux — pourtant presque rafraîchissant d'honnêteté à ce sujet. « Une ville où les morts et les vivants commercent côte à côte, unis par la cupidité », observe Idrinth. « Je me trouve étrangement à l'aise ici. Personne ne prétend que je ne suis pas ce que je suis. Personne n'exige que je joue une humanité que je ne possède plus. » Il fait une pause. « C'est peut-être pour cela que je devrais partir rapidement. »

trans-unit.source: The ruins of Lahmia whisper of ancient glory and the first vampires. Idrinth walks through the empty streets with something approaching reverence. "Where it all began. Neferata and her court, the first to drink from Nagash's poisoned cup." He kneels beside a toppled statue. "I have studied the histories. The first vampires were scholars, queens, warriors of great refinement. Look at what their legacy became. Look at what I became."
trans-unit.target: Les ruines de Lahmia murmurent d'une gloire ancienne et des premiers vampires. Idrinth marche dans les rues vides avec quelque chose approchant la révérence. « Là où tout a commencé. Neferata et sa cour, les premiers à boire de la coupe empoisonnée de Nagash. » Il s'agenouille près d'une statue renversée. « J'ai étudié les histoires. Les premiers vampires étaient des érudits, des reines, des guerriers d'un grand raffinement. Regardez ce qu'est devenu leur héritage. Regardez ce que je suis devenu. »

trans-unit.source: The North Tower of the Sorceresses looms dark against the northern sky, Morathi's power palpable even at a distance. Idrinth's jaw tightens. "The mother of the Witch King. The one who brought Chaos-worship to elvenkind." His voice carries cold hatred. "I have killed many servants of the Dark Powers. But this one... this one would be worth any cost." He does not approach. Not yet. "Patience. Vengeance is eternal. I have time."
trans-unit.target: La Tour Nord des Sorcières se dresse sombre contre le ciel septentrional, le pouvoir de Morathi palpable même à distance. La mâchoire d'Idrinth se serre. « La mère du Roi Sorcier. Celle qui a apporté le culte du Chaos au peuple elfique. » Sa voix porte une haine froide. « J'ai tué beaucoup de serviteurs des Puissances Ténébreuses. Mais celle-ci... celle-ci vaudrait n'importe quel prix. » Il n'approche pas. Pas encore. « Patience. La vengeance est éternelle. J'ai le temps. »

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: L'étranger retire sa cape de voyage avec une grâce pratiquée, révélant une armure elfique en dessous. « J'ai servi aux côtés de chevaliers auparavant », dit-il, inclinant la tête avec une précision courtoise. « L'honneur et le devoir transcendent les frontières des races. Votre Dame protège ces terres, et je voudrais les voir défendues contre les ténèbres qui consument tout. » Ses traits pâles restent composés, bien que ses lèvres exsangues ne trahissent aucune chaleur. « Chevauchons contre notre ennemi commun. »

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: L'étranger repousse sa capuche, révélant des traits indubitablement Asur — pourtant ses yeux ne portent rien de leur dédain habituel. « Cousin », dit-il, le mot ne portant ni moquerie ni chaleur. « Je me moque des anciennes rancunes. Le Chaos dévore Druchii et Asur également, et j'ai appris que la survie exige... de la flexibilité. » Un sourire sans joie traverse ses lèvres exsangues. « Vous comprenez le pragmatisme mieux que la plupart. Allons-nous le mettre à profit ? »

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: La silhouette encapuchonnée s'incline avec une formalité inattendue, puis se redresse pour révéler des traits elfiques sous ses vêtements de voyage. « J'ai parcouru vos terres auparavant, dans des âges passés », déclare-t-il, sa voix mesurée et calme. « La Grande Bastion retient des horreurs que je ne connais que trop bien. L'équilibre doit être maintenu contre les Puissances Ruineuses. » Ses yeux sans âge étudient les officiels Cathayans avec un intérêt savant. « J'offre des connaissances s'étendant sur des millénaires. Peut-être pouvons-nous apprendre l'un de l'autre. »

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: La capuche de l'étranger tombe, révélant un visage elfique intact par le temps. « Je sais qui vous servez », dit-il platement, soutenant le regard des morts-vivants sans broncher. « Et je sais ce que je suis. Nous n'avons pas besoin de prétendre le contraire. » Il ajuste la grande épée à son dos avec une aisance familière. « Les ennemis de Nagash sont les serviteurs du Chaos. Pour l'instant, cet alignement d'objectifs suffit. » Ses lèvres exsangues se tordent en quelque chose ressemblant à un sombre amusement. « Le Grand Nécromancien collecte toutes choses finalement. Je choisis simplement les termes. »

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: L'étranger se défait de sa cape tachée de sel, révélant des traits elfiques et une armure ancienne en dessous. « J'ai navigué sur des mers plus sombres que celles-ci », remarque-t-il, regardant l'équipage chancelant sans dégoût. « Le sang est le sang, qu'il soit pris sur terre ou sur l'eau. » Il sort sa bourse de paiement, la soupesant pensivement. « Vous chassez, vous pillez, vous survivez. Je respecte cela. » Un sourire entendu traverse son visage pâle. « Et je soupçonne que vos capitaines comprennent — l'immortalité change la perspective sur... tout. »

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: A robed stranger appears one night, offering his help for a small fee. Do you accept the help?
trans-unit.target: Uno straniero incappucciato appare una notte, offrendo il suo aiuto per una piccola tariffa. Accetti l'aiuto?

trans-unit.source: The Stranger
trans-unit.target: Lo Straniero

trans-unit.source: An elven messanger arrives, looking for an Idrinth. The Idrinth you know has avoided him so far, maybe you could help?
trans-unit.target: Un messaggero elfico arriva, cercando un Idrinth. L'Idrinth che conosci lo ha evitato finora, forse potresti aiutare?

trans-unit.source: A wood elf ranger arrives at your camp site. Stating that he is in need of his bloodied cousin. While Idrinth quickly confirms, that he was meant, he refuses to meet.
trans-unit.target: Un ranger degli elfi silvani arriva al tuo accampamento. Afferma di aver bisogno del suo cugino insanguinato. Mentre Idrinth conferma rapidamente di essere lui, rifiuta di incontrarlo.

trans-unit.source: An old scholar approaches your camp. Carrying books of the past, she claims to have found valuable knowledge for you.
trans-unit.target: Un'anziana studiosa si avvicina al tuo campo. Portando libri del passato, afferma di aver trovato conoscenze preziose per te.

trans-unit.source: At night, while an icy wind tortures your guards, they catch a kislevite trying to sneak into the camp. He is young and seemingly harmless, but what do you do with him?
trans-unit.target: Di notte, mentre un vento gelido tormenta le tue guardie, catturano un kislevita che tenta di intrufolarsi nel campo. È giovane e apparentemente innocuo, ma cosa fai con lui?

trans-unit.source: One night you find one of your servants drained of blood right outside Idrinth's tent. Rushing in, you find him reading an old scroll sitting at his table.
trans-unit.target: Una notte trovi uno dei tuoi servitori prosciugato di sangue proprio fuori dalla tenda di Idrinth. Precipitandoti dentro, lo trovi che legge un'antica pergamena seduto al suo tavolo.

trans-unit.source: The Messeger
trans-unit.target: Il Messaggero

trans-unit.source: Blood Cousins
trans-unit.target: Cugini di Sangue

trans-unit.source: Intruder!
trans-unit.target: Intruso!

trans-unit.source: The Scholar
trans-unit.target: La Studiosa

trans-unit.source: The Servant's End
trans-unit.target: La Fine del Servitore

trans-unit.source: A group of dwarves have been spotted nearby. Your scouts have listened in on their stories about the vampire wars. One elf mentioned sounds suspiciously like Idrinth.
trans-unit.target: Un gruppo di nani è stato avvistato nelle vicinanze. I tuoi esploratori hanno origliato le loro storie sulle guerre vampiriche. Un elfo menzionato assomiglia sospettosamente a Idrinth.

trans-unit.source: An old feud
trans-unit.target: Un'Antica Faida

trans-unit.source: After the latest hunt Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven weapon. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Dopo l'ultima caccia, Idrinth ti avvicina con quella che sembra un'antica arma elfica. Ti chiede consiglio su a chi dedicarla.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Weapon
trans-unit.target: Un'Arma Benedetta

trans-unit.source: After the latest battle Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven armour. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Dopo l'ultima battaglia, Idrinth ti avvicina con quella che sembra un'antica armatura elfica. Ti chiede consiglio su a chi dedicarla.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Armour
trans-unit.target: Un'Armatura Benedetta

trans-unit.source: After the finishing travel for the day Idrinth approaches you with what looks like an ancient elven talisman. He asks you for advise on who to dedicate it to.
trans-unit.target: Dopo aver concluso il viaggio della giornata, Idrinth ti avvicina con quello che sembra un antico talismano elfico. Ti chiede consiglio su a chi dedicarlo.

trans-unit.source: A Blessed Talisman
trans-unit.target: Un Talismano Benedetto

trans-unit.source: Activate stricter lore friendliness to limit the recruiting cultures for Knight-Scholar Idrinth Thalui to High Elves, Wood Elves, Kislev, The Empire and Vampire Counts. Choose looser mode to have Vampire Coast, Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves, Cathay and Bretonia in the list as well.
trans-unit.target: Attiva l'aderenza più stretta alla lore per limitare le culture di reclutamento del Cavaliere-Studioso Idrinth Thalui ad Alti Elfi, Elfi Silvani, Kislev, L'Impero e Conti Vampiro. Scegli la modalità più libera per avere anche Costa dei Vampiri, Legioni di Nagash, Elfi Oscuri, Cathay e Bretonnia nella lista.

trans-unit.source: Mode: Stricter or Looser Lore Friendliness
trans-unit.target: Modalità: Aderenza alla Lore Stretta o Libera

trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger introduces himself as a fellow Asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel robes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: Dopo aver accettato le tue monete, lo straniero si presenta come un compagno Asur di nome Idrinth. Togliendo i suoi abiti da viaggio, vedi l'armatura consumata dalle battaglie di un maestro della sapienza, una spadona abbinata e un arco di metallo vicino a occhi stoici che fanno intuire brutalità ancora da commettere.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: Non vedo l'ora di combattere al fianco dei cacciatori dei boschi, cugino, afferma l'asur con tono amichevole mentre raccoglie il suo pagamento e il mantello da viaggio. Potrei non essere bravo nel tiro quanto voi, ma non vi rallenterò. Un sorriso leggermente divertito gioca sulle sue labbra esangui prima di scomparire. Facciamo una caccia di cui si parlerà ancora per secoli!

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: Lo straniero si sveste dopo essere stato pagato e rivela un volto elfico e armi elfiche sotto i suoi abiti da viaggio. Mi chiamo Idrinth, ho combattuto i nostri nemici per più tempo di quanto la maggior parte di voi abbia vissuto. Mi piacerebbe allenarmi con la forza e insegnare loro. Un leggero sorriso gioca sulle sue labbra esangui prima di scomparire in un volto senza età.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: Ho combattuto e sanguinato con guerrieri che credono in Ulric o Sigmar. Abbiamo gli stessi nemici, afferma mentre si toglie gli abiti da viaggio, e non vedo l'ora di respingerli insieme a voi. Condividendo la mia conoscenza per il miglioramento del mondo. I suoi occhi guardano freddamente gli umani in preghiera prima di tornare all'attenzione sul generale e la sua guardia.

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: Lo straniero abbassa il cappuccio, rivelando lineamenti elfici. Non sono amico della distruzione, ma i nostri nemici mi hanno costretto ad agire. Mettendo in tasca le sue monete afferma, Tornare dalla famiglia dopo molti anni quando sono in pericolo è giusto, non importa chi sia quella famiglia. Non sei d'accordo?

trans-unit.source: Idrinth Thalui
trans-unit.target: Idrinth Thalui

trans-unit.source: Do you want to enable the Thaluian Chapels for your campaign? They offer further defenses and options compared to just having the hero.
trans-unit.target: Vuoi abilitare le Cappelle Thaluiane per la tua campagna? Offrono ulteriori difese e opzioni rispetto ad avere solo l'eroe.

trans-unit.source: To recruit Idrinth Thalui, the Knight-Scholar, you will need to have a general with a minimum level. How early do you want to be able to recruit him?
trans-unit.target: Per reclutare Idrinth Thalui, il Cavaliere-Studioso, avrai bisogno di un generale con un livello minimo. Quanto presto vuoi poterlo reclutare?

trans-unit.source: Story Events
trans-unit.target: Eventi della Storia

trans-unit.source: Do you want to enable story events when Idrinth reaches specific, important places?
trans-unit.target: Vuoi abilitare gli eventi della storia quando Idrinth raggiunge luoghi specifici e importanti?

trans-unit.source: The Thaluian Chapels
trans-unit.target: Le Cappelle Thaluiane

trans-unit.source: Rank of Renown
trans-unit.target: Grado di Rinomanza

trans-unit.source: Drakenhof
trans-unit.target: Drakenhof

trans-unit.source: Temple of Khaine
trans-unit.target: Tempio di Khaine

trans-unit.source: Shrine of Khaine
